description: This file defines the SugarFolder class, which manages folder operations such as creation, deletion, subscription management, and retrieval within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It handles email folder structures, dynamic queries, and user-specific folder settings.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: Class managing folder operations such as creation, deletion, subscription management, and retrieval within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including email folder structures and user-specific settings.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromAllFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from all folders.

methods.name: deleteEmailFromFolder
methods.description: Deletes an email from a specific folder.

methods.name: checkEmailExistForFolder
methods.description: Checks if an email exists in the folder.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves beans from one folder to another.

methods.name: copyBean
methods.description: Copies a bean from one folder to another.

methods.name: setFolder
methods.description: Creates a new group folder from provided fields.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns GUIDs of folders the user is subscribed to.

methods.name: setSubscriptions
methods.description: Sets a user's folder subscriptions.

methods.name: insertFolderSubscription
methods.description: Creates a folder subscription entry for a user.

methods.name: getParentIDRecursive
methods.description: Recursively finds parent folder IDs until root.

methods.name: clearSubscriptions
methods.description: Deletes subscriptions for a user.

methods.name: clearSubscriptionsForFolder
methods.description: Deletes all subscriptions for a specific folder.

methods.name: generateArchiveFolderQuery
methods.description: Returns SQL query for archive folder emails.

methods.name: generateSugarsDynamicFolderQuery
methods.description: Generates dynamic folder email query based on folder type.

methods.name: getListItemsForEmailXML
methods.description: Retrieves email list items for display in XML format.

methods.name: getDynamicFolderCount
methods.description: Returns count of items in a dynamic folder.

methods.name: getCountItems
methods.description: Returns total item count in a folder.

methods.name: getCountUnread
methods.description: Returns count of unread items in a folder.

methods.name: addBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean with the folder.

methods.name: retrieveFoldersForProcessing
methods.description: Retrieves folders for processing, including subscriptions and user permissions.

methods.name: getGroupFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares group folders for user settings display.

methods.name: getFoldersForSettings
methods.description: Prepares folders for user settings, including nested folders.

methods.name: removeDeletedFolders
methods.description: Removes folders marked as deleted.

methods.name: getFoldersChildForSettings
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child folders for settings.

methods.name: getCountNewItems
methods.description: Returns count of new items based on criteria.

methods.name: getUserFolders
methods.description: Builds folder tree for user display.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeRefresh
methods.description: Builds a folder node for refresh in UI.

methods.name: buildTreeNodeFolders
methods.description: Builds folder tree nodes for display.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Flags a folder as deleted.

methods.name: deleteChildrenCascade
methods.description: Deletes all child folders recursively.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves folder data to database.

methods.name: addSubscriptionsToGroupFolder
methods.description: Adds default subscriptions to a group folder.

methods.name: createSubscriptionForUser
methods.description: Creates a subscription for a user.

methods.name: updateFolder
methods.description: Updates folder information.

methods.name: findAllChildren
methods.description: Finds all child folders recursively.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves folder data by ID.

methods.name: getFirstDisplayFolders
methods.description: Returns the first folder to display.

methods.name: isToDisplay
methods.description: Checks if a folder should be displayed based on subscriptions.

methods.name: shouldFolderDisplay
methods.description: Helper to determine if folder matches display criteria.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleInboundIds
methods.description: Retrieves inbound email account IDs accessible by user.
